value.rationale: The theorem completely determines all first-block triangular residue frequencies for every modulus, resolving the explicit 2022 prime-power and even-factor saturation conjectures, and establishes a sharp parity correction to the stated squarefree multiplicity spectrum. The quantity is a natural studied invariant, the even-lifting identity is structural rather than arbitrary numerical checking, and the result covers unbounded families rather than isolated examples.
